description: This file defines a module for training machine learning models from uploaded datasets. It includes data preprocessing functions, model training routines for classification and regression, and handles model serialization with metadata. It provides a public interface function `train_from_upload` to process data files and produce trained models with evaluation metrics.

classes.name: TrainingResult
classes.description: Structured result of a training operation, serializable to JSON, containing model ID, path, task type, target, metrics, and timestamp.

methods.name: str _infer_task_type(y: pd.Series)
methods.description: Infers whether the target variable corresponds to a regression or classification task based on its dtype and number of unique values.

methods.name: Tuple[pd.DataFrame,pd.Series] _prepare_features(df: pd.DataFrame, target_column: str)
methods.description: Preprocesses the uploaded dataset by handling missing values, encoding categorical variables, and splitting features and target.

methods.name: pd.DataFrame _read_uploaded_to_dataframe(file_bytes: bytes, filename: str)
methods.description: Reads uploaded file bytes into a pandas DataFrame supporting CSV and Excel formats.

methods.name: _train_model(X: pd.DataFrame, y: pd.Series, task_type: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Trains a simple RandomForest model for either classification or regression, and returns the trained model along with the task type and evaluation metrics.

methods.name: _to_json_safe(value)
methods.description: Converts numpy types, NaN, and infinite values into JSON-serializable Python types.

methods.name: TrainingResult _store_artifact(model, meta: Dict[str, Union[str, int, float]])
methods.description: Serializes the trained model with joblib, writes metadata, and returns a TrainingResult object.

methods.name: TrainingResult train_from_upload( file_bytes: bytes, filename: str, target_column: Optional[str] = None, task_type: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Public interface to accept uploaded data, preprocess, train, and store a model, returning metadata including metrics.
